cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
# find column index of '0-15'
for c in range(1,13):
    if ws.cell(5,c).value == '0-15':
        col = c
print('0-15 at col', col)
# insert column at B (col 2), shifting existing columns right
ws.insert_cols(2)
# now '0-15' is at col 3, shift it to col 2
ws.cell(5,3).value = ws.cell(5,3).value
# move the whole column 3 to 2
for r in range(1,12):
    ws.cell(r,2).value = ws.cell(r,3).value
# clear col 3
for r in range(1,12):
    ws.cell(r,3).value = None
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
